race.comment: Of the runners with race experience NEVER PEGASUS (3) is head and shoulders above. Has raced near the speed and battled on well although never looking a winning hope in his two runs to date, the latest over 1100m at Gawler. Blinkers on might give him that extra length or two. VIA NICCOLINA (9) filled a minor placing first-up over this course and distance but has struggled in two subsequent appearances. Another with the shades on for the first time which might spark a revival. POCKET PYRO (10) is a first starter with two jump-out wins from as many outings. Bred to want a lot further than this but she does look ready for a bright start. ZOURADO (11) is a Zousain filly on debut. Finished second in a recent Murray Bridge jump-out. Must be respected. TOTAL LOVE (4) weakened badly first-up over this course and distance. Fitter and can offer a bit more this time. FAST FOOD (5) from the Jolly stable lines up for the first time. Trial form has been encouraging.
